mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within 3 months indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies struggle with production and inventory management.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% each within 3 months signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.5% each in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% each within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% each within 3 months signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST & GDPC1 increase > 1% each in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 increase by more than 1% each within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a high-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 5%) signals supply-side constraints, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% and CPIAUCSL is above 5%.
